title: Drivers of Electricity Affordability
content: In an era when electricity demand exceeds supply, wholesale market operators, policymakers, and regulators are considering subtle yet fundamental changes to market operations and industry practices. The significant increases in demand from tech and data center companies and their impact on rising costs are spurring top state officials to become directly involved in how markets operate.
author: Paul A. DeCotis
